system.name: PipeLLM
system.one_liner: a user-transparent runtime that pipelines encryption with GPU computation for confidential LLM serving

components.name: App
components.role: application process running on the CPU that issues memory copies to the GPU

components.name: PipeInfer
components.role: CPU-side runtime component; also reused as the name of the third placement policy

components.name: Plaintext
components.role: unencrypted data buffer before encryption, always allocated in CVM private memory

components.name: temp
components.role: ciphertext temp buffer; color indicates whether it sits in CVM private or shared memory

components.name: Bounce
components.role: policy: encrypt into private memory then copy into shared memory before sending to the GPU

components.name: Zero-copy
components.role: policy: encrypt directly into shared memory, avoiding the extra copy

components.name: PipeInfer
components.role: policy: pipelines the encrypt step with GPU computation before copying to shared memory

components.name: Inplace
components.role: policy: decrypts a shared ciphertext buffer, then re-encrypts it in place with a new IV

components.name: GPU
components.role: receives ciphertext from shared memory via DMA for confidential computation

flows.what: Encrypt into CVM private memory (Bounce policy)
Copy from private to shared memory (Bounce policy)
Encrypt directly into shared memory (Zero-copy policy)
piped Encrypt overlapped with GPU computation (PipeInfer policy)
Decrypt then re-Encrypt in place (Inplace policy)
ciphertext DMA transfer to the GPU

content.key_idea: Four alternative ciphertext-placement policies (Bounce, Zero-copy, PipeInfer, Inplace) trade off extra memory copies and buffer location for the ability to pipeline encryption with GPU computation.
content.reading_order: Top-down through four stacked policy rows (Bounce, Zero-copy, PipeInfer, Inplace); each row read left to right from the CPU/App through Memory to the GPU box on the right.

Ciphertext(P) — ciphertext in CVM private memory (purple)

summary: PipeLLM is a runtime that hides GPU confidential-computing encryption overhead by pipelining encryption with computation. This figure compares four ciphertext placement policies inside a confidential VM's application address space: Bounce (encrypt into private memory, then copy to shared memory), Zero-copy (encrypt directly into shared memory), PipeInfer (pipeline the encrypt step with GPU computation, then copy), and Inplace (decrypt a shared buffer, then re-encrypt it in place). Each policy is drawn as a light-orange banded row showing the App issuing data, an Encrypt/Copy/Decrypt sequence acting on a 'temp' buffer colored by memory location (green plaintext, purple CVM-private ciphertext, orange CVM-shared ciphertext), and a final DMA arrow into the GPU box. A small legend defines the color coding and distinguishes solid 'Runtime' arrows from dashed 'Piped' arrows.
summary_zh: 该图比较了机密虚拟机中四种密文放置策略（Bounce、Zero-copy、PipeInfer、Inplace），展示明文如何加密、复制并通过 DMA 传给 GPU，并用颜色区分明文与不同内存位置的密文。
notes: Component label 'PipeInfer' is overloaded: it names both the CPU-side runtime process and the third policy row; treated here as a repeated label rather than distinct systems.
